Install the tag on your site

Step 1 — find your measurement ID

Your measurement ID looks like G-AB12CD34 and is shown in Admin › Data Streams. Your Universal Analytics property, if you still have one, uses the older UA-XXXXXX-X form.

Step 2 — paste the tag

Copy the snippet below into the <head> of every page, replacing G-XXXXXXXX with the measurement ID from step 1.

<!-- Google tag (gtag.js) -->
<script async src="https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=G-XXXXXXXX"></script>
<script>
  window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
  function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}
  gtag('js', new Date());
  gtag('config', 'G-XXXXXXXX');
</script>

Step 3 — or install through a container

If you manage tags through a container, use your own container ID in place of GTM-EXAMPLE:

<script>(function(w,d,s,l,i){w[l]=w[l]||[];w[l].push({'gtm.start':
new Date().getTime(),event:'gtm.js'});var f=d.getElementsByTagName(s)[0],
j=d.createElement(s),dl=l!='dataLayer'?'&l='+l:'';j.async=true;
j.src='https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtm.js?id='+i+dl;
f.parentNode.insertBefore(j,f);})(window,document,'script','dataLayer','GTM-EXAMPLE');</script>

Step 4 — conversion and monetisation tags

Google Ads conversion tags take the form AW-XXXXXXXXX, and an AdSense publisher ID takes the form ca-pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX. Both are visible in the respective product console.

<ins class="adsbygoogle"
     data-ad-client="ca-pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
     data-ad-slot="0000000000"></ins>

For the Meta pixel, call fbq('init', '<YOUR_PIXEL_ID>') after the base code.
